2. Hazard Identification

DANGER
H290 May be corrosive to metals.
H314 Causes severe skin burns and eye damage.
Pictograms: corrosion. Classification: Skin Corr. 1A; Eye Dam. 1; Met. Corr. 1.

Precautionary: P260 do not breathe mist. P280 wear protective gloves, clothing, eye and face protection. P305+P351+P338 if in eyes, rinse cautiously with water for several minutes.
